name: Mersive Smart
description_en:
Mersive Smart is a product in the Team collaboration category. Its directory profile covers Brainstorming, Audio Video Conferencing, Content Management, Contact Management, Document Management.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Not available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $144.0.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: organize content through creation, revision and publication; store and organize people, organizations and their contact details; organize documents and control their access and revisions. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Mersive Smart 属于团队协作软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括头脑风暴、音视频会议、内容管理、联系人管理、文档管理。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为未提供。资料所列支持方式为工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 起价为 $144.0.。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：组织内容的创建、修订和发布；集中保存和整理联系人、组织及其联系方式；整理文档并管理访问权限与版本。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。

community_follow_up.reason_en: Official Smart documentation actually read: software-only Android TV/streaming receiver with separately assigned subscription plan. Assigned product URL now redirects in actual browser to Polaris Launch hardware, no-subscription offer shipping Q1 2027. Documentation pricing link returns actual404. Current Smart order availability, price and migration/entitlement continuity cannot be established; do not overwrite Smart with Launch or adopt third-party144dollar price.
